answer: An operator running many aliases hence forfeits for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the harbor quota and the wharf admission check. Submission rate is limited to 2 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole fleet from one uplink. Because the counters live in the falcon ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
